title_o: Cognitive-Behavioral Guided Self-Help for the Treatment of Recurrent Binge Eating

replications.quote: At the 12-month follow-up, CBT-GSH resulted in greater remission from binge eating (35%, N=26) than usual care (14%, N=10)
At the 12-month follow-up, CBT-GSH resulted in greater remission from binge eating (35%, N=26) than usual care (14%, N=10) (number needed to treat=5).
